Photo 1 shows the same keyboard from a slightly different angle, still wrapped in plastic, with the same model label visible.
The keyboard has 61 keys, standard black and white keys, and a control panel with buttons, a dial, and a small screen.
The brand 'Casio' is visible in white text on the top right of the control panel in both photos.
The keyboard appears to be new or unused, as it is fully wrapped in plastic with no visible signs of wear or damage.
